title: Book One · Chapter 149: The Upside Down Stool
story:
The stool looks different with its feet in the air. Ronan can see the wood under the seat. Two pieces meet there. One place has opened a little. Another is still tight.

Dad puts some tools on the old cloth. Ronan sits away from Dad's tools. He must not bump Dad's arm. He has the clean rag on his knee. When Dad asks for it, he passes it by one corner.

“Will it look new?” he asks.

“No. It will look like our stool.”

“But it will work.”

“That is the plan.”

Dad does not hurry. He looks at the wood. He cleans the open part. Then he tries to fit the two parts together. “What will you do next?” Ronan asks. “This part needs time,” Dad says. “I can check this other part now.” He does not let Ronan hold anything near a sharp tool.

Outside, Mr Qiu sells an envelope. Mrs Lan says the black cat has been in her front room again. Mum comes back with a bag of cloth and stops to look at the stool.

“At last,” she says.

Dad looks up. “It has waited politely.”

“I have been less polite.”

Ronan laughs. Mum often moves the stool out of the way. Someone might forget and sit on its loose leg. Dad is not fixing it just for school. They need a seat they can use at supper.

Dad puts it aside when he has finished the first part. It cannot be sat on yet. Ronan wants to test it at once. “We must wait,” Dad says. “Then we can use it.” The leg is not ready yet.

Dad marks the waiting place with the old cloth. He asks Ronan to tell Mum not to move it by one leg. Ronan waits until Mum comes through the kitchen. Then he gives her Dad's message. She looks for a place for her own work. Mum leaves the stool on the cloth. She will not use it by mistake.

They take the ball outside for ten minutes. Dad misses a throw and has to fetch it from behind a pot. Ronan misses the next one. They do not keep score.

At supper they use the other chairs. The stool stays on its cloth. Dad looks at the invitation. Then he puts his work shirt away. Ronan sees the invitation in the tool box. He does not ask about the old-home drawing.

The next evening Dad checks the stool again. He turns it upright and puts his hand on each side. Then he sits on it slowly, stands, and looks underneath once more.

“Now?” Ronan asks.

“Now you can sit.”

Ronan sits with both feet on the ground. The stool does not shift. He moves his weight a little, as Dad asks. It stays firm.

Mum brings her sewing bag. “My turn.”

Ronan stands. She sits and pulls the bag onto her lap. She likes this low seat by the doorway. The light is good here. She puts thread through her needle and begins sewing.

Dad smiles at her. Mum can sit and work on the stool again. Ronan looks from Mum to Dad. He smiles too.

Ronan takes out a plain sheet. He draws the stool from the side. He draws four legs and a low square seat. No shop, no moving cart, and no sad face go beside it.

“May I show you a different idea tomorrow?” he asks.

Dad watches Mum settle her feet beneath the stool. “Tomorrow,” he says. Dad has not agreed yet. Ronan has tonight to think about his new idea.
studyGuide:
---

重点表达：seat＝凳面、座位；upright＝正放；weight＝重量。

情节提示：rag＝抹布；firm＝稳固的；needle＝缝衣针。

理解：1. 为什么修好后不能立刻坐上去？2. 这张凳子在家中有什么实际用途？
